title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30420: add service post and send events
summary: Service-Post and Send codeunit now includes extension points that allow integrations to support additional service document types and coordinate posting and sending behavior through new events.
key_points: Added pre-confirmation event to let extensions support additional document types
Added pre-post event to allow extensions to substitute posting logic
Extensions can now determine whether sending should proceed based on posting results
Eliminates need for copying the codeunit or using limited standard Service-Post routine
Enables safe coordination between posting and sending phases
